get.summary: Read exact authorized Run policy bytes
get.description: Authorize selected Run and every evidence owner before lookup/disclosure. Only retained associations qualify; no-store and nosniff apply to every response. Reject query/body, Range and conditional requests with 400. Uniform 404 for unknown, invisible, unassociated or not-yet-bound evidence. Authorized unsupported format or oversized evidence is 422; integrity failure is 503 without partial bytes. Normative semantics: docs/run-evidence-reads.md.
